edits.why: maude-v2's tokens are scoped to .maude-v2[data-theme]; light is its default theme.

notes: maude-v2 has no .callout / .callout--info, .panel or .btn--icon; they are used here (the changes summary, the compare panels, the icon buttons) and will render unstyled until restyled with maude-v2 parts (.island, .icon-btn) or added to DiffView.css.
The canvas is marked handed-off. Switching changes what was handed off, so check with whoever took it.
The theme goes from dark to light. Use data-theme="dark" instead if the dark look should stay.
The comments in DiffView.css still name system/maude.
